findings.description: The outer candidate gate short-circuits in order: P11, continuation causes, stop-after-confirmation. Parent-stop needs no box check, and noncontinuing phase skips cause constraints. Exact equal winning keys keep the first accepted candidate. P22 itself does not independently require stop after gate: P25 adds that condition when the native service is used.
findings.resolution: Clarify active source-derived contract; no production change.

findings.description: The cancellation above flag is exact PL, while floor selection is exact PH. RAW opposing inspection uses the last timestamp at or before the cancellation instant with no extra local bounds validation. Normal equal cancellation/winner is handled later, not as cancel_is_next.
findings.resolution: Clarify active source-derived contract; no production change.
